name: Sayban - Panel Support Reply / Status / Close / Messages
notes: Import and split into 4 webhooks if preferred. SQL below is the source of truth.

sql.getMessages: SELECT m.* FROM support__messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = ? ORDER BY m.id ASC;
reply: INSERT INTO support__messages (conversation_id, sender_id, sender_type, message) VALUES (?, ?, 'superadmin', ?);
UPDATE support__conversations SET last_message = ?, last_message_at = NOW(), message_count = message_count + 1, status = 'answered', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?;
INSERT INTO users__notification (userId, title, text, action, notification_type) SELECT user_id, 'پاسخ پشتیبانی', ?, CONCAT('/support_chat_', id), 'system' FROM support__conversations WHERE id = ?;
sql.status: UPDATE support__conversations SET status = ?, closed_at = IF(? = 'closed', NOW(), closed_at), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?;
sql.close: UPDATE support__conversations SET status = 'closed', closed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?;

auth: panel JWT role must be super_admin for panel/* ; user JWT + ownership for support/*
